blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Malacañang on Friday said the Marcos administration shares the business groups’ calls to prevent the misuse of funds in the proposed 2027 national budget. The statement came after more than 30 business and civil society organizations urged Congress to make sure that no budget insertions that lack technical justifications will be allowed in next year’s budget. READ: ‘Budget insertions’ alarm business groups anew The groups also called for measures that will prevent a repeat of the “ghost” and substandard flood control projects that had tainted previous appropriations.
